tools.name: ilang_runtime
tools.description: iLang is a specification between humans and AI: before the AI acts, it defines what that action is authorized to become; after, code checks whether it was done right. Return the official iLang runtime, the working text of the specification (about 18,600 tokens), verified against the canon's sha256.

tools.name: ilang_runtime_lite
tools.description: Return iLang runtime lite: the two syntaxes, the verb table (88 verbs with their 13 Greek aliases), the 29 modifiers, the error codes, the declaration body forms, the registry of 32 declarations and the entity registry (25 entities), taken word for word from the canon's full runtime and checked agai

tools.name: ilang_full
tools.description: Return a section of the full specification that the core runtime leaves out, found by its heading (for example "Declaration Grammar" or "Boundary Cases"), or the whole full text when no heading is given.

tools.name: ilang_validate
tools.description: Check iLang text with the canon grammar and registry validator. Returns error, warning and info counts and each finding with its line, code and message. An E302 finding (unknown modifier) may also carry did_you_mean, the registered modifier this server suggests for the key; the suggestion is added h

tools.name: ilang_lookup
tools.description: [GET:@DICT|whr=q=term]=>[Ω] Look up an iLang verb, modifier, entity or declaration by name, alias or meaning. Returns type, name, alias, category, meaning, values and source_url. not_found=true when nothing matches; never invent terms.

tools.name: ilang_faq
tools.description: [GET:@FAQ|whr=q=question]=>[Ω] Return the published ilang.ai FAQ entries closest to a question about the protocol (what it is, MCP/A2A comparison, prompt compression, versions, judgment layer, SOUL, the Source Book). Includes source_url.

tools.name: ilang_soul
tools.description: [GET:@SOUL|whr=form]=>[Ω] Return SOUL 2.0, the published iLang document that sets how an AI behaves by default: a judgment layer for its default persona.
